# DebateLab by Pi-Stack

DebateLab by Pi-Stack is an AI debate preparation platform at https://debate.pi-stack.org/.

Important public pages:
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/ — homepage
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/ai-debate-practice — AI debate practice overview
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debate-case-generator — case generation
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debate-rebuttal-practice — rebuttal practice
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/debatelab-pricing — plans and pricing
- https://debate.pi-stack.org/sitemap.xml — every public page

Product summary: DebateLab helps students, coaches, and competitive debaters generate cases, practice rebuttals, find evidence leads, map argument flowcharts, ask for coaching, and time speeches.
